description: Use before submitting a mobile or web app to the Apple App Store, Google Play or Google OAuth verification. Pass an inventory of what the app collects, which SDKs it uses and which Google scopes it requests (build it by reading the repo). Returns the problems reviewers are likely to reject, how to fix each one, and which paid package generates the missing documents. Free. The first call returns an app_token: save it in .approvekit.json at the project root and pass it on later calls so the app is updated instead of duplicated.

app_token.description: The app_token returned by audit_app. It is stored in .approvekit.json at the project root. Omit on the first audit of an app.

account_deletion_in_app.description: True if the app already lets users delete their account from inside the app.

account_deletion_url.description: Existing public page where users can request account deletion, if any.

auth_providers.description: How users sign in, e.g. "Sign in with Apple", "Google", "email and password", "Supabase Auth".

bundle_ids.description: iOS bundle identifier and Android application id.

purpose.description: Why it is collected, e.g. "account login", "analytics".

shared_with.description: Third parties that receive this data.

type.description: Kind of data, e.g. "email", "precise location", "photos", "purchase history".

developer_name.description: Legal name that appears in the policies, usually the company or the individual developer.

google_oauth_scopes.description: Full Google OAuth scope URLs the app requests, if it uses Sign in with Google or Google APIs.

has_user_accounts.description: True if users can sign up or log in.

permissions.description: iOS usage-description keys and Android permissions the app declares, e.g. NSCameraUsageDescription, android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.

play_developer_account.description: Google Play account type: personal created after 2023-11-13 (closed-testing requirement applies), personal created before, or organization. Ask the user.

privacy_policy_url.description: Existing privacy policy URL, if any.

stack.description: How the app is built. Expo config plugins add permission strings automatically, so some checks differ.

support_email.description: Public contact address for privacy and deletion requests.

third_party_sdks.description: SDKs found in the dependencies, e.g. "Firebase Analytics", "RevenueCat", "Sentry".

name: audit_app
title: Audit an app for store and Google OAuth review
